text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-u-n-n-e-d a f-a-k-e g-p-s s-i-g-n-a l a-t t-r-a c-t-o-r, l-e-f-t a l-o-g f-i-l-e o-f t-h-e s-i-m-u-l-a t-e-d b-e-a-c-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-r-e-a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-p-l-o-a-d-e-d a p-l-a-y b-a-c-k r-o-u-t-e d-a-t-a-s-e-t, l-e-f-t a c-o-p-y o-f t-h-e c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e c-a-c-h-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-a-t-a-i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-l-s-e s-i-g-n-a-l w-e-a-k-n-e-s-s p-a-t-t-e-r-n, l-e-f-t t-h-e c-o-m-m-a-n-d h-i-s-t-o-r-y f-i-l-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e p-r-e-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-t-e-n-e-d t-h-e p-r-o-x-y l-a-p-t-o-p i-m-a-g-e, l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k p-c-a-p-t-u-r-e f-i-l-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-m-a-g-e h-a-s-h.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-e-t-e-d a p-o-r-t-i-o-n o-f t-h-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y l-o-g, l-e-f-t a n-o-t-e f-i-l-e w-i-t-h t-h-e t-e-s-t s-c-o-p-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-i-n-a-l s-i-g-n-o-f-f r-e-v-i-e-w.
